comment: Provider-name-contamination allowlist consulted case-insensitively by validate-capability-registry.py's check (g), REQ-003(g), ADR-0018's provider-neutrality boundary. This list is itself provider-neutral data (it names providers only to detect their names, the same way a profanity filter's word list is not itself profane) and is expected to grow as new providers are named in real Provider Bindings (ADR-0018 item 4).
